text: Use the portal route /vessel-registration for Boat, Jet Ski, and Dhow new registration.
The three supported registration types are Boat (Vessel Registration), Jet Ski Registration, and Dhow Registration.
General flow for new registration: choose registration type, complete details, upload required documents, then submit.
For Boat registration, Ship Name is required, max length is 13, and name availability is validated in the UI.
For Boat registration, alternate ship names (Name 1 to Name 4) are required and each has max length 13.
For Boat registration, Hull Number is required, max length is 50, and it must be unique.
For Boat registration, Type of Hull is required; if value is Other, Type of Hull Other becomes required.
For Boat registration, Classification is required; if value is Other, Classification Other becomes required.
For Boat registration, Berthing Place is required; if value is Other, Berthing Place Other becomes required.
For Boat registration, Port of Registry is Bahrain and is fixed (disabled in form).
For Boat registration, if Previously Registered is Yes, previous name, previous registration number, previous registration date, and previous port of registry are required.
For Boat registration, at least one engine is required and maximum allowed engines are four.
For Boat registration, each engine requires Engines Type and HP; if Engines Type is Other, Engines Type Other is required.
For Boat registration, Copy Of CPR is a required document.
For Boat registration, Builder Certificate is required when Previously Registered is No.
For Boat registration, Deletion Certificate is required when Previously Registered is Yes.
For Boat registration, Customs Declaration is required when Place of Build is not Bahrain.
For Boat registration, Mortgage Deed is required when Vessel Mortgaged is Yes.
For Boat registration, optional uploads include Bill Of Sale, Other Document, and Vessel Image.
Boat submission succeeds only when form validation passes, required documents are provided, Hull Number is unique, and vessel name checks pass.
For Jet Ski registration, Hull Number is required, max length is 50, and must be unique.
For Jet Ski registration, Type of Hull is required; if value is Other, Type of Hull Other becomes required.
For Jet Ski registration, Berthing Place is required; if value is Other, Berthing Place Other becomes required.
For Jet Ski registration, Engines Type and HP are required; if Engines Type is Other, Engines Type Other becomes required.
For Jet Ski registration, Port of Registry is Bahrain and is fixed (disabled in form).
For Jet Ski registration, if Previously Registered is Yes, previous registration number, previous registration date, and previous port of registry are required.
For Jet Ski registration, CPR Copy is required.
For Jet Ski registration, Builder Certificate is required when Previously Registered is No.
For Jet Ski registration, Deletion Certificate is required when Previously Registered is Yes.
For Jet Ski registration, Customs Declaration is required when Place of Build is not Bahrain.
For Jet Ski registration, optional uploads include Photo Of Jet Ski, Bill Of Sale, Insurance Certificate, Other, and Jet Ski Image.
Jet Ski submission succeeds only when form validation passes, required documents are provided, and Hull Number is unique.
Dhow registration uses the vessel registration flow with Dhow classification behavior.
For Dhow registration, Ship Name and alternate ship names are required with the same name limits as Boat registration.
For Dhow registration, Hull Number is required and must be unique.
For Dhow registration, at least one engine is required and maximum allowed engines are four.
For Dhow registration, Copy Of CPR is required.
For Dhow registration, Builder Certificate is required when Previously Registered is No.
For Dhow registration, Deletion Certificate is required when Previously Registered is Yes.
For Dhow registration, Customs Declaration is required when Place of Build is not Bahrain.
For Dhow registration, Mortgage Deed is required when Vessel Mortgaged is Yes.
For Dhow registration, optional uploads include Bill Of Sale, Other Document, and Vessel Image.
Dhow submission succeeds only when form validation passes, required documents are provided, Hull Number is unique, and vessel name checks pass.
